defect_corrected: The prior restart verifier required exact state-head equality, but rotating the admin seed legitimately registers a new local service-worker token and UUID worker

correction.new_records: Exactly one derived worker-token and one UUIDv4 service worker with the fixed name, full service scope, nonrevoked state and new analysis-key binding
correction.existing_records: Every existing complete state row, including browser session tombstones and old workers, remains byte-identical
correction.worker_index: Only the newly derived worker key is excluded from the original lens_workers checksum; each new index record must match an immutable payload, fixed scope, revision bound and published head
correction.publication_race: Only a validated next heartbeat revision allows eight bounded read-only resamples at 200 ms; foreign records fail immediately and an abandoned publication still fails
correction.complete_inventory: A bounded all-head LEFT JOIN verifies every payload and digest, rejects duplicate keys and empty fences, and runs in both observed and stopped guards before session CAS mutation

session_attribution.basis: Unique timing plus full private before/after key, revision, digest and value inventory; no plaintext cookie retained
session_attribution.manifest_policy: Root must explicitly review and replace the old three-record private baseline with exactly the reviewed four records near dispatch; any fifth record or other drift remains a hard refusal

derived_query_credentials.reviewed_behavior: Stable ClickHouse user identity is derived from the exact database and query scope; its password is derived from the admin seed and ALTER USER runs when the restarted process first provisions that scope
derived_query_credentials.postrotation_check: Admin SELECT of retained trace count provisions QueryScope::All with the rotated seed
derived_query_credentials.retained_limitation: Previously provisioned unvisited scopes may retain valid old derived passwords until visited again

existing_manifests: Intentionally stale and refused by updated source pins
